Technical & price structure: In plain terms: the committed backlog, the delivered El Gouna and O West communities, the owned hotels and the recurring town-management income underpin a bear-case ~EGP 22.5 floor — which, on these (derived) inputs, sits well below today's price. The upside is the El Gouna land bank: the discount to a bottom-up RNAV is, overwhelmingly, the market ascribing almost nothing to the unlaunched El Gouna and Red Sea land. Unlike most EGX developers, ORHD's USD-linked hotel and town income makes a weaker pound a partial tailwind rather than a headwind, and the balance sheet sits close to net-cash.
